quarterly_data.quarter: NextEra Energy press release: DOE Site in Western Kentucky Revitalized with Data Center (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: DOE selected NextEra Energy to build and own the dedicated generation resources powering a data center campus that Brookfield will lease, develop and operate at the DOE Paducah Site in Western Kentucky: up to 2 GW of natural gas and up to 2.6 GW of battery energy storage systems, added in stages as the campus ramps up. Once fully constructed in 2032 the $100 billion privately-funded campus will support up to 1.8 GW of utility capacity and over 1.2 GW of compute capacity, backed by up to 4.6 GW of dedicated generation. The project is subject to negotiation and execution of definitive documentation. CEO: 'The data center will bring its own power, pay for its own power infrastructure'.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 2 GW natural gas + up to 2.6 GW battery storage (up to 4.6 GW dedicated generation); campus up to 1.8 GW utility capacity, over 1.2 GW compute; full construction 2032; subject to definitive documentation
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: data center campus developer/operator served by NextEra's dedicated generation (DOE selection, definitive documentation pending)
